# Name: # 32 MB of flash (sdkconfig.defaults). Three app slots of 5.3 MB
# below 16 MB: the cache maps 24-bit flash addresses only
# that lifts that is experimental (Espressif: not stable on every chip)
# so an app above 16 MB can neither be verified nor booted; data is read
# through the flash driver and may sit above. `factory` is what USB
# flashes and what the bootloader falls back to when both update slots
# fail (and what a user may later keep a proven firmware in); an update
# is written to whichever of ota_0/ota_1 is not running; otadata says
# which boots and whether it is confirmed. NVS keeps the Wi-Fi hint; its
# offset stays where it has been so a new table keeps it. storage is for
# an app larger than its slot; the app is 4.35 MB at 0.1.6.
